player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin wasan Rock-Paper-Scissors na zagaye {num_rounds}. Manufarka ita ce cin nasarar zagaye da yawa. A kowane zagaye, amsa da ɗayan: '[rock]', '[paper]', ko '[scissors]'. Hakanan zaka iya amfani da '[r]', '[p]', ko '[s]' a matsayin gajarta .

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ba a gane motsi ba. Yi amfani da [rock], [paper], ko [scissors].

message.round_win: Sakamakon zagaye: Mai kunnawa {winner} ya ci nasara!

outcome.p0_wins: Mai kunnawa 0 ya lashe mafi yawan zagaye!
outcome.p1_wins: Mai wasa 1 ya lashe mafi yawan zagaye!
